name: DSAIReadable
framework: React 19 / Next.js 16 / Tailwind CSS v4 / shadcn/ui

shadcn_excluded.reason: shadcn/ui's former form layer, built on react-hook-form. shadcn/ui now builds its forms on Field, which the design system ships: Field lays out the label, the control, the description and the error, and leaves the form state to whichever library the app uses.

Added to shadcn/ui in October 2026 and not shipped yet: whether the design system adopts it is decided in https://github.com/Toniio/DSAIReadable/issues/179. Until then, no component renders a code block.

Added to shadcn/ui in October 2026 and not shipped yet: whether the design system adopts it is decided in https://github.com/Toniio/DSAIReadable/issues/179. Upstream builds its expandable lines on Collapsible, which the design system ships.
